SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT flag FROM cerror_new WHERE group_error = @cat_id and err_code = @id )='Y',0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear limit 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_rdu_pcu(
id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
target int(10) DEFAULT 0,
ri_q1 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
ri_q2 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
ri_q3 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
ri_q4 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
ad_q1 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
ad_q2 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
ad_q3 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
ad_q4 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
q1 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
q2 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
q3 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
q4 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
ri int(10) DEFAULT 0,
ad int(10) DEFAULT 0,
result int(10) DEFAULT 0,

PRIMARY KEY (id, hospcode, areacode, b_year),
KEY (hospcode),
KEY (areacode),
KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_rdu_pcu WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_rdu_pcu 
(
SELECT
@id,h.hoscode,concat(h.provcode,h.distcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2) ,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com
,@b_year+543 as b_year
,1 as target
,IF(IFNULL(((IFNULL(s1.r10,0)+IFNULL(s1.r11,0)+IFNULL(s1.r12,0))/(IFNULL(s1.t10,0)+IFNULL(s1.t11,0)+IFNULL(s1.t12,0))),0)*100 <=20,1,0) ri_q1
,IF(IFNULL(((IFNULL(s1.r01,0)+IFNULL(s1.r02,0)+IFNULL(s1.r03,0))/(IFNULL(s1.t01,0)+IFNULL(s1.t02,0)+IFNULL(s1.t03,0))),0)*100 <=20,1,0) ri_q2
,IF(IFNULL(((IFNULL(s1.r04,0)+IFNULL(s1.r05,0)+IFNULL(s1.r06,0))/(IFNULL(s1.t04,0)+IFNULL(s1.t05,0)+IFNULL(s1.t06,0))),0)*100 <=20,1,0) ri_q3
,IF(IFNULL(((IFNULL(s1.r07,0)+IFNULL(s1.r08,0)+IFNULL(s1.r09,0))/(IFNULL(s1.t07,0)+IFNULL(s1.t08,0)+IFNULL(s1.t09,0))),0)*100 <=20,1,0) ri_q4

,IF(IFNULL(((IFNULL(s2.r10,0)+IFNULL(s2.r11,0)+IFNULL(s2.r12,0))/(IFNULL(s2.t10,0)+IFNULL(s2.t11,0)+IFNULL(s2.t12,0))),0)*100 <=20,1,0) ad_q1
,IF(IFNULL(((IFNULL(s2.r01,0)+IFNULL(s2.r02,0)+IFNULL(s2.r03,0))/(IFNULL(s2.t01,0)+IFNULL(s2.t02,0)+IFNULL(s2.t03,0))),0)*100 <=20,1,0) ad_q2
,IF(IFNULL(((IFNULL(s2.r04,0)+IFNULL(s2.r05,0)+IFNULL(s2.r06,0))/(IFNULL(s2.t04,0)+IFNULL(s2.t05,0)+IFNULL(s2.t06,0))),0)*100 <=20,1,0) ad_q3
,IF(IFNULL(((IFNULL(s2.r07,0)+IFNULL(s2.r08,0)+IFNULL(s2.r09,0))/(IFNULL(s2.t07,0)+IFNULL(s2.t08,0)+IFNULL(s2.t09,0))),0)*100 <=20,1,0) ad_q4

,IF(IFNULL(((IFNULL(s1.r10,0)+IFNULL(s1.r11,0)+IFNULL(s1.r12,0))/(IFNULL(s1.t10,0)+IFNULL(s1.t11,0)+IFNULL(s1.t12,0))),0)*100 <=20  
AND IFNULL(((IFNULL(s2.r10,0)+IFNULL(s2.r11,0)+IFNULL(s2.r12,0))/(IFNULL(s2.t10,0)+IFNULL(s2.t11,0)+IFNULL(s2.t12,0))),0)*100 <=20,1,0) q1

,IF(IFNULL(((IFNULL(s1.r01,0)+IFNULL(s1.r02,0)+IFNULL(s1.r03,0))/(IFNULL(s1.t01,0)+IFNULL(s1.t02,0)+IFNULL(s1.t03,0))),0)*100 <=20 
AND IFNULL(((IFNULL(s2.r01,0)+IFNULL(s2.r02,0)+IFNULL(s2.r03,0))/(IFNULL(s2.t01,0)+IFNULL(s2.t02,0)+IFNULL(s2.t03,0))),0)*100 <=20,1,0) q2

,IF(IFNULL(((IFNULL(s1.r04,0)+IFNULL(s1.r05,0)+IFNULL(s1.r06,0))/(IFNULL(s1.t04,0)+IFNULL(s1.t05,0)+IFNULL(s1.t06,0))),0)*100 <=20 

AND IFNULL(((IFNULL(s2.r04,0)+IFNULL(s2.r05,0)+IFNULL(s2.r06,0))/(IFNULL(s2.t04,0)+IFNULL(s2.t05,0)+IFNULL(s2.t06,0))),0)*100 <=20,1,0) q3

,IF(IFNULL(((IFNULL(s1.r07,0)+IFNULL(s1.r08,0)+IFNULL(s1.r09,0))/(IFNULL(s1.t07,0)+IFNULL(s1.t08,0)+IFNULL(s1.t09,0))),0)*100 <=20 

AND IFNULL(((IFNULL(s2.r07,0)+IFNULL(s2.r08,0)+IFNULL(s2.r09,0))/(IFNULL(s2.t07,0)+IFNULL(s2.t08,0)+IFNULL(s2.t09,0))),0)*100 <=20,1,0) q4

,IF(IFNULL(((IFNULL(s1.r10,0)+IFNULL(s1.r11,0)+IFNULL(s1.r12,0)+IFNULL(s1.r01,0)+IFNULL(s1.r02,0)+IFNULL(s1.r03,0)+IFNULL(s1.r04,0)+IFNULL(s1.r05,0)+IFNULL(s1.r06,0)+IFNULL(s1.r07,0)+IFNULL(s1.r08,0)+IFNULL(s1.r09,0))/(IFNULL(s1.t10,0)+IFNULL(s1.t11,0)+IFNULL(s1.t12,0)+IFNULL(s1.t01,0)+IFNULL(s1.t02,0)+IFNULL(s1.t03,0)+IFNULL(s1.t04,0)+IFNULL(s1.t05,0)+IFNULL(s1.t06,0)+IFNULL(s1.t07,0)+IFNULL(s1.t08,0)+IFNULL(s1.t09,0))),0)*100 <=20,1,0) ri

,IF(IFNULL(((IFNULL(s2.r10,0)+IFNULL(s2.r11,0)+IFNULL(s2.r12,0)+IFNULL(s2.r01,0)+IFNULL(s2.r02,0)+IFNULL(s2.r03,0)+IFNULL(s2.r04,0)+IFNULL(s2.r05,0)+IFNULL(s2.r06,0)+IFNULL(s2.r07,0)+IFNULL(s2.r08,0)+IFNULL(s2.r09,0))/(IFNULL(s2.t10,0)+IFNULL(s2.t11,0)+IFNULL(s2.t12,0)+IFNULL(s2.t01,0)+IFNULL(s2.t02,0)+IFNULL(s2.t03,0)+IFNULL(s2.t04,0)+IFNULL(s2.t05,0)+IFNULL(s2.t06,0)+IFNULL(s2.t07,0)+IFNULL(s2.t08,0)+IFNULL(s2.t09,0))),0)*100 <=20,1,0) ad

,IF(IFNULL(((IFNULL(s1.r10,0)+IFNULL(s1.r11,0)+IFNULL(s1.r12,0)+IFNULL(s1.r01,0)+IFNULL(s1.r02,0)+IFNULL(s1.r03,0)+IFNULL(s1.r04,0)+IFNULL(s1.r05,0)+IFNULL(s1.r06,0)+IFNULL(s1.r07,0)+IFNULL(s1.r08,0)+IFNULL(s1.r09,0))/(IFNULL(s1.t10,0)+IFNULL(s1.t11,0)+IFNULL(s1.t12,0)+IFNULL(s1.t01,0)+IFNULL(s1.t02,0)+IFNULL(s1.t03,0)+IFNULL(s1.t04,0)+IFNULL(s1.t05,0)+IFNULL(s1.t06,0)+IFNULL(s1.t07,0)+IFNULL(s1.t08,0)+IFNULL(s1.t09,0))),0)*100 <=20 

AND IFNULL(((IFNULL(s2.r10,0)+IFNULL(s2.r11,0)+IFNULL(s2.r12,0)+IFNULL(s2.r01,0)+IFNULL(s2.r02,0)+IFNULL(s2.r03,0)+IFNULL(s2.r04,0)+IFNULL(s2.r05,0)+IFNULL(s2.r06,0)+IFNULL(s2.r07,0)+IFNULL(s2.r08,0)+IFNULL(s2.r09,0))/(IFNULL(s2.t10,0)+IFNULL(s2.t11,0)+IFNULL(s2.t12,0)+IFNULL(s2.t01,0)+IFNULL(s2.t02,0)+IFNULL(s2.t03,0)+IFNULL(s2.t04,0)+IFNULL(s2.t05,0)+IFNULL(s2.t06,0)+IFNULL(s2.t07,0)+IFNULL(s2.t08,0)+IFNULL(s2.t09,0))),0)*100 <=20,1,0) result

FROM
chospital h 
LEFT JOIN s_rdu19 s1 ON h.hoscode=s1.hospcode AND s1.b_year=@b_year+543
LEFT JOIN s_rdu20 s2 ON h.hoscode=s2.hospcode AND s2.b_year=@b_year+543
WHERE h.provcode in(@prov_c) AND h.hdc_regist=1 AND h.hostype not IN(1,2,5,6,7,11,12,15,16)
);

/*q1*/
UPDATE s_rdu_pcu 
SET q2=0,ad_q2=0,ri_q2=0 
,q3=0,ad_q3=0,ri_q3=0 
,q4=0,ad_q4=0,ri_q4=0 
WHERE @b_year>DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y')  AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

/*q2*/
UPDATE s_rdu_pcu 
SET q3=0,ad_q3=0,ri_q3=0 
,q4=0,ad_q4=0,ri_q4=0 
WHERE @b_year=DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y') AND  DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m')<CONCAT(@b_year,'04') AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

/*q3*/
UPDATE s_rdu_pcu 
SET q4=0,ad_q4=0,ri_q4=0 
WHERE @b_year=DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y') AND  DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m')<CONCAT(@b_year,'07') AND b_year=(@b_year+543);
rows.aname: จำนวน รพ.สต.และหน่วยบริการปฐมภูมิในเครือข่ายที่มีอัตราการใช้ยาปฏิชีวนะในโรค RI และ AD  ≤ ร้อยละ 20 ทั้ง 2 โรค

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("target") AS "target", SUM("ri_q1") AS "ri_q1", SUM("ri_q2") AS "ri_q2", SUM("ri_q3") AS "ri_q3", SUM("ri_q4") AS "ri_q4", SUM("ad_q1") AS "ad_q1", SUM("ad_q2") AS "ad_q2", SUM("ad_q3") AS "ad_q3", SUM("ad_q4") AS "ad_q4", SUM("q1") AS "q1", SUM("q2") AS "q2", SUM("q3") AS "q3", SUM("q4") AS "q4", SUM("ri") AS "ri", SUM("ad") AS "ad", SUM("result") AS "result"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code

service_plan.query: SELECT h.splevel as a_code ,h.splevel as a_name , SUM(target) AS target,  SUM(ri_q1) AS ri_q1, SUM(ri_q2) AS ri_q2, SUM(ri_q3) AS ri_q3, SUM(ri_q4) AS ri_q4,  SUM(ad_q1) AS ad_q1, SUM(ad_q2) AS ad_q2, SUM(ad_q3) AS ad_q3, SUM(ad_q4) AS ad_q4,  SUM(q1) AS q1, SUM(q2) AS q2, SUM(q3) AS q3, SUM(q4) AS q4,  SUM(ri) AS ri, SUM(ad) AS ad, SUM(result) AS result  FROM (SELECT * FROM ccmihosp WHERE byear={{YEAR}}) as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hcode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} JOIN chospital as c ON c.hoscode = h.hcode WHERE (c.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (c.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (c.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (c.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (c.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (c.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (c.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (c.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (h.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY CAST(regbed AS DECIMAL) DESC
